summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Experienced training and deploying detection models, including YOLO object detectors and OCR-free document understanding transformers, on real sensor and image data using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers. Built GPT style language models from scratch and applied LLMs for real-time intent classification within a working Python pipeline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free visual document understanding transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured text detection and field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the Hugging Face VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific tokens and resized decoder embedding layers.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset of 1,133 images for health level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n achieving 83% mAP@50 on held out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for production mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi modal MRI dataset with augmentation and memory management for large scale volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation models with VGG and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy versus latency trade offs for deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real time data acquisition and experimental visualization; used GitLab and JupyterHub for version control and collaborative analysis.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by approximately 55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, profiling peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC, achieving under 1% accuracy degradation for near lossless compression.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch (self attention, MLP blocks, weight tying) with a TikToken based tokenizer and custom training loop.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice controlled, vision guided robotic pick and place system with a Flask-SocketIO server bridging a mobile client and a Jetson controller over a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated TensorRT optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup, 92 FPS) for visual servoing and Gemini based LLM intent classification under 500ms for real time command interpretation.
Resolved 11 integration failures to reach 100% pick reliability across 10 of 10 trials.
